title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young fae and Oko's son, who is uneasy about his father's methods and challenges Akul to a duel.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A fae shapeshifter who leads the crew and manipulates his son Kellan's desire for approval.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A sharpshooter and former Freestrider who joined Oko's crew to stop Akul, who injured her nephew.

entities.name: Fortune
entities.description: Annie's horse-like companion.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon on Oko's crew who turns a Hellspur to stone in the saloon fight.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who extracts the Outcaster's memories and learns the key is one of six.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer who is sent with her brother to Thief's Folly to retrieve a map.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A necromancer who heals Umezawa and retrieves the map to Tarnation.

entities.name: Satoru Umezawa
entities.description: A thief on the crew whose wound is stitched by Geralf.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin explosives expert.

entities.name: Tinybones
entities.description: A skeleton thief who steals Breeches's flask.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A warlock who guards the Outcaster.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A giant demon who guards the Outcaster.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch whose charms keep Nolan euphoric.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A winged siren who patrols the sky for the crew.

entities.name: Nolan
entities.description: A captured Outcaster whose mind Ashiok searches and whom Annie and Kellan escort to an oasis.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: The dragon leader of the Hellspurs who wears five key pieces in a medallion and assembles all six after capturing Oko's crew.

entities.name: Twist Fandango
entities.description: One of Akul's inner circle, who captures the crew in a Tarnation saloon.

entities.name: Bertram Graywater
entities.description: The Sterling Company leader whom Oko has robbed twice.

entities.name: Annie's nephew
entities.description: A nephew badly injured by Akul during a failed exchange.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: Akul's outlaw gang that hides the city of Tarnation.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: The company the crew evaded after the train incident.

entities.name: Freestriders
entities.description: An outlaw group Annie belonged to that robbed Akul.

entities.name: Outcasters
entities.description: Hermit wilderness dwellers.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: The hidden Hellspur city beneath the floating vault, full of lava rivers and bone-framed buildings.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: A jagged floating rock above Tarnation that is the vault.

entities.name: Thief's Folly
entities.description: A graveyard for prospectors where the map to Tarnation was buried.

entities.name: Hardbristle
entities.description: A place days from where the Outcaster is left.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane where Kellan confronted Ashiok.

entities.name: The six keys
entities.description: Six pieces of one key, five held in Akul's medallion and the sixth stolen by Oko.

events.summary: At a camp after the escape, Ashiok extracts memories from the captured Outcaster Nolan.
events.quote: Memories were pulled out of Nolan's mind, leaving streaks of silver threads in the air.

events.summary: Kellan confronts Oko about the plan and Oko reassures him, claiming he trusted him to handle the train.
events.quote: you're my son, and I trust you.

events.summary: Ashiok reports that the artifact is one of six keys, Akul holds the other five in a medallion, and a map to Tarnation is buried in Thief's Folly.
events.quote: Akul has the other five. He wears them in a medallion around his neck

events.summary: Oko sends Gisa and Geralf to retrieve the map from Thief's Folly.
events.quote: "Are the two of you up for a little side mission?"

events.summary: Annie and Kellan agree to escort Nolan to an oasis so he can make his way home.
events.quote: I can go with Kellan and escort the Outcaster to the nearest oasis.

events.summary: Annie tells Kellan how Akul hunted the Freestriders and injured her nephew, and why she cannot let him get the vault's power.
events.quote: A while back, I was with the Freestriders.

events.summary: Gisa and Geralf return with the map, revealing the path to Tarnation and the vault.
events.quote: "I believe this is what you were after."

events.summary: Oko plans to enter Tarnation disguised as Hellspurs with Vraska, Annie and Kellan to reach Akul.
events.quote: We'll split up the team and take a small group of four into the city,

events.summary: Oko chooses Kellan as the fourth, privately noting that flattery keeps his son loyal.
events.quote: Flattery, it seemed, was the key to keeping his son on his side.

events.summary: The infiltration team enters Tarnation, where Hellspurs duel openly.
events.quote: A small crowd jeered and roared, and when one of the axes landed in the other man's chest, the onlookers raised their arms in triumph.

events.summary: Annie identifies Twist Fandango, one of Akul's crew, in a saloon.
events.quote: "That's Twist Fandango. One of Akul's crew."

events.summary: Three Hellspurs rough up Kellan and Oko intervenes, sparking a saloon brawl in which Vraska turns one Hellspur to stone.
events.quote: and used her gaze to turn them to stone.

events.summary: Twist Fandango and Akul's inner circle capture Oko, Kellan, Annie and Vraska.
events.quote: clamping a pair of iron cuffs to his wrists.

events.summary: Akul mocks Annie about her nephew and says he will watch them suffer.
events.quote: How is that nephew of yours?

events.summary: Akul confronts the chained crew, takes the sixth key from Oko and assembles the full key in his medallion.
events.quote: Akul slotted the sixth key into the medallion

events.summary: Kellan challenges Akul to a duel; Oko and the others goad Akul's pride until he agrees to a duel at midnight.

relations.note: Oko is Kellan's father and uses his need for approval.
The necromancer siblings are sent together to Thief's Folly.
relations.quote: Oko studied each member of the crew before landing on the necromancer siblings.
my nephew was badly injured during the exchange.

relations.note: Twist is one of Akul's crew.

relations.quote: His crew filled in behind him, hungry for entertainment.

relations.note: Annie has helped Kellan twice and they grow close.
relations.quote: That's twice you've helped me. Thank you.

relations.note: Annie used to be a Freestrider.
relations.quote: A while back, I was with the Freestriders.

relations.note: The vault floats above the city of Tarnation.
relations.quote: So—the vault floats above the city.
